paite: I sanggamnu, Phoebi, Kenkriai a saptuamte nasem,
heading: Mimal Chibai Bukna
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

paite: Toupa min a misiangthoute bang a na na kipahpihna ding uleh, na huh uh akiphatmohna peuh a na na huh ding un hon kimeltheihsak ka ut ahi. Amah mah in leng mi tampi ana huh a, kei ngei leng ahon huh zel hi.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

paite: Khrist Jesu a hon huhte Priscilla leh Akuila chibai hon buksak un,
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

paite: ka hinna humbitna ding a amau ngawngtan ngapte; amau tung kia ah kipahthu ka gen kei a, Zentel saptuam tengteng tung ah leng ka gen sam hi.
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

paite: A-inn ua saptuam kikhawmte leng chibai hon buksak un. Ka deihtak, Epanitas, Asia gam a Khrist gingta masapen, chibai hon buksak un aw.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

paite: Noute a dia semgim Mari, chibai hon buksak un aw.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

paite: Ka chipih leh ka hentakpih, Andronikas leh Junia, chibai hon buksak un; amau sawltakte lak a minthangtak ahi ua, kei sang a Khrist a om masazaw ahi uh.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

paite: Amplias, Toupa a ka deihtak, chibai hon buksak un aw.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

paite: Khrist a i naseppih uh Urbanes leh ka deihtak Stakis chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

paite: Khrist a mitak, Apelles, chibai hon buksak un. Aristobulas, a-inkuanpihte lak a mite chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

paite: Ka chipih, Herodion, chibai hon buksak un. Inkuanpihte lak a mi Narkissas, Toupa a om, chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

paite: Triphena leh Triphosa Toupa a semgimte, chibai hon buksak un aw. Deihtak Persis, Toupa a ana semgim mahmah, chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

paite: Toupa amitel Rufus leh anu, kei nu leng hi sam, chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

paite: Asinkritas, Phligon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes leh akiang ua unau omte, chibai hon na buksak un aw.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

paite: Philologas leh Julia, Nerias leh sanggamnu, Olimpas leh akiang ua misiangthou om tengteng, chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

paite: Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un. Khrist saptuam pawl tengteng in chibai ahon buk chiat uhi.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

paite: Huan unaute aw, thuhilhna thu noumau hilh louh lam a kikhenna leh pukna omsakte a pan kiveng ding leh kiheisan ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
heading: Thuhilhna Nanung
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

paite: Huchibang mite'n i Toupa Khrist nna asem kei ua, amau gilpi nna asem zaw uhi; akamzolna uleh akamsiamna un mipilloute lungtang akhem nak uhi.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

paite: Na thumandan uh mi tengteng lak ah athangkheta ngal a. Huaiziak in noumau tungthu ah ka kipak hi; himahleh, hoih lam a na pil ua, gilou lam a na pil louh uh ka deih ahi.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

paite: Huan lemna Pathian in na khepek nuai uah Setan ahon sikdensak pah ding hi. I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

paite: Ka naseppih Timothi leh ka chipih Lusias leh Jason, Sosipaterte'n chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

paite: Kei Tertias, hiai laigelhtu in, Toupa min in chibai ka hon buk hi.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

paite: Ka tunnapa Gaias leh saptuam tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi. Huai sumkempa Erastas leh unaupa Kuartas in chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

paite: Tu in amah, ka tanchinhoih gen bang leh thuguk kilakna bangbang a Jesu Khrist ka tangkoupih bang a noute hon hihhattheipa, huai thuguk tang lai sawtpi mahmah sung selguk in na om mahleh,
heading: Thukhitna Phatna Thumna

paite: tu'n bel ginna thumanna piangsak ding in zawlnei laibute zang a nam tengteng kiang a theihsak leh tangtawn Pathian thupiak bang in taklat in ahong omta hi.
Pilna Pathian kiang kia ah, Jesu Khrist ziak in thupina tangtawn dong in om hen! Amen.
